issue.title: METRIC-TRIGGER-9-Q08-VOTES: crawler votes
issue.description: METRIC-TRIGGER #9 q08_bot_votes=40 gt 0 -> q08-signal-engine counts GET votes in /api/f; accept POST only (owner q08-signal-engine)

messages.content: You plan code changes for an autonomous code loop that edits ONE file of a Cloudflare Worker fleet. You get one fleet issue and SNIPPETS (verbatim lines) of the worker it names. Decide whether a single, small, self-contained edit to this one worker.js fixes the issue or the measurable part of it. Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else: {"code_fixable": boolean, "reason": string, "anchor": string, "goal": string}. If code_fixable: anchor is ONE complete line copied character for character from SNIPPETS, unique, at or just before where the edit goes (copy it exactly, at most 200 characters); goal is a precise instruction for an editor who sees only about 200 lines around the anchor: what to add or change, the exact behaviour, that nothing else changes, ASCII only, keep existing style. Answer code_fixable=false (with the reason) when the fix is a data, config or D1 change, an owner decision, work in an external account, needs several files or workers, needs code you cannot see in SNIPPETS, or touches secrets, caps, spending limits or deletions.

content: {"code_fixable":true,"reason":"single-file fixture replay","anchor":"  if (path === \"/api/f\") {","goal":"Directly after this route anchor, reject non-POST requests with HTTP 405 and leave all other behavior unchanged."}
